name: earth-app/strata
description: Advanced backups and instant rollback for Drupal over S3-compatible storage

suggest.ext-zstd: Zstandard compression. Measured 6.20x with a trained dictionary at 8 KiB frames, against 3.52x for gzip.
suggest.ext-brotli: Brotli compression. Higher ratio than gzip at much lower throughput.
suggest.ext-redis: Backs the write journal with a Redis stream instead of a database table.
suggest.drupal/redis: Required by strata_redis to capture authoritative ephemeral state.
suggest.phpseclib/phpseclib: Required by strata_sftp for SFTP storage.

scripts-descriptions.analyze: Runs PHPStan over src/ at the level pinned in phpstan.neon.
scripts-descriptions.lint: Runs phpcs with the ruleset in phpcs.xml.dist.
scripts-descriptions.lint:fix: Runs phpcbf over the same ruleset.
